@graph.name: FRANKY'S design system reference
@graph.headline: FRANKY'S design system | Refero Styles
@graph.description: Explore FRANKY'S's light E-commerce design system: Arcade Cream #f3e5df, Ink Black #000000 colors, Arcade typography, and DESIGN.md for AI agents.

dos: Use Arcade 400 for body, labels, prices, and captions; jump to Arcade 700 only for titles, nav items, and the footer links — the weight shift is the entire hierarchy.
Set every CTA, tag, and toggle to a 6px radius (or 9999px for the inline 'AR' pill) and add the 1px inset cream highlight (#f3e5df 0px 1px 0px 0px inset) to keep the arcade-button bevel.
Use Buy Green (#128e44) only for the filled Add-To-Cart button; never reuse it for links, borders, or hover states.
Anchor the page on Arcade Cream (#f3e5df); use Pixel Gray (#e5e7eb) for 1px structural rules and card borders, Ink Black (#000000) for text and checkerboard contrast.
Reserve Marquee Orange (#faa21f) for the top announcement bar and the optional Marquee Sheen gradient — it should never appear as a button fill or large text color.
Keep vertical rhythm in 4px increments; element gaps live at 4–8px, card padding at 12px, and section gaps at 43–61px.
Pair every product card with a Try-In-AR ghost button stacked above the Add-To-Cart (or Out-Of-Stock) button so the right-hand grid stays uniform.
donts: Don't introduce a second typeface — no system fonts, no sans-serifs, no display scripts. Arcade is the brand.
Don't use soft drop shadows; the only shadow allowed is the 1px inset cream highlight on buttons and the flat #333333 under the floating cap.
Don't round cards above 12px or buttons below 6px — the 6/12/9999px triad is the only permitted radius vocabulary.
Don't place Buy Green (#128e44) on a non-purchase element, and don't pair it with the Marquee Sheen gradient in the same component.
Don't dilute the checkerboard — it must read as pure #000000 against #f3e5df (or #333333 for shadow tones), never as a tinted gray or blurred pattern.
Don't use dark-mode backgrounds; the canvas is always Arcade Cream, even inside cards and modals.
Don't exceed 18px on any text or drop below 10px — the Arcade font's bitmap grid breaks outside that range.

designSystem.layout: Full-bleed single-screen product page on desktop, max-width 1200px centered. Top-to-bottom rhythm: orange marquee bar → cream header with black rule → two-column split (55% hero checkerboard / 45% 2-column product card grid) → cream footer strip. On mobile, the hero collapses to a full-width checkerboard and the grid becomes a single column. Cards are evenly distributed in a 2-column grid with Pixel Gray (#e5e7eb) hairline dividers between them. Section gaps are tight (43–61px) and the interface never uses full-bleed dark bands — the cream canvas runs uninterrupted.
designSystem.imagery: Photography of caps on a pure cream backdrop, centered and tightly cropped, with a soft charcoal contact shadow beneath. No lifestyle, no models, no context — the cap is the hero. The checkerboard behind the hero doubles as a graphic surface. No illustrations, no 3D renders beyond the AR toggle, no decorative icons beyond the pixel cross in the wordmark.

similar.why: Same flat cream canvas, bold black-bordered product cards, and a single warm accent (Polar's red, Franky's orange) on a marquee bar
Pixel/bitmap-influenced type system, checkerboard product framing, and the 6px-radius beveled button look
Compact cream-and-black product grid with tight padding and a single chromatic CTA color
Warm off-white surfaces, monospaced/pixel-adjacent labels, and minimal-but-precise card radii

surfaces.name: Arcade Cream
surfaces.purpose: Page canvas — warm off-white that makes the pixel font breathe

surfaces.name: Pixel Gray
surfaces.purpose: Grid gutter tone and product card background variation

surfaces.name: Charcoal
surfaces.purpose: Checkerboard shadow squares and tertiary surface

surfaces.name: Carbon
surfaces.purpose: Deepest checkerboard tone, near-black illustration fills

elevation.style: inset 0 1px 0 0 #f3e5df — 1px cream pixel-highlight at the top edge
flat #333333 drop, no blur, sits directly under the product

gradients.name: Marquee Sheen
gradients.role: Top announcement bar — orange fading through cream back to orange, the site's only non-flat chromatic surface

gradients.name: Checkerboard Blue-Orange
gradients.role: Subtle diagonal wash on the 3D product showcase

designSystem.northStar: Retro arcade kiosk on a skate-shop counter.

components.name: Marquee Announcement Bar
components.description: Full-width band filled with the Marquee Sheen gradient (orange → cream → orange). Arcade 14px/400, letter-spacing normal, black or dark-brown text. Height ~36px, flush with the top of the viewport. It is the only decorative chromatic surface on the page.

components.name: Header Bar
components.description: Cream (#f3e5df) background, 1px solid #000000 bottom border. Wordmark 'franky's' set in Arcade 18px/700 in #000000 with a small black cross pixel-icon. Hamburger menu on the right (three 2px black lines, 16px apart). No drop shadow, no sticky elevation — it sits flat on the cream canvas.

components.name: Product Showcase Panel (3D/AR)
components.description: Large left-hand panel (roughly 55% of viewport width) with a black-and-cream checkerboard floor receding in perspective. A charcoal (#333333) cap floats centered with a soft #333333 shadow. Bottom-center contains two pill toggles: '3D' and 'AR', each 6px radius, 1px inset cream highlight (#f3e5df 0px 1px 0px 0px inset), 2px 8px padding, Arcade 14px/400.

components.name: Product Card
components.description: Cream (#f3e5df) background, 12px radius, 1px solid #e5e7eb border. Internal padding 12px. Product image fills the top ~70% of the card on a pure cream backdrop. Title (e.g. 'FRANKY'S GREEN 665') in Arcade 14px/700 #000000 at the bottom-left, price in Arcade 14px/400 #000000 at the bottom-right. Two stacked controls under the title area: ghost 'TRY IN AR' button and filled or ghost 'ADD TO CART' / 'OUT OF STOCK' button.

components.name: Try In AR Button (Ghost)
components.description: 6px radius, transparent fill, 1px solid #000000 border, Arcade 14px/400 #000000. Padding 4px 12px. The 'AR' suffix is wrapped in a tiny pill (9999px) to read as a badge.

components.name: Add To Cart Button (Filled Green)
components.description: 6px radius, #128e44 background, Arcade 14px/700 #ffffff (white) text, fully uppercase. Padding 8px 12px. Optional 1px inset cream highlight (#f3e5df 0px 1px 0px 0px inset) to keep the arcade-button feel. This is the only green surface in the system.

components.name: Out Of Stock Button (Disabled Ghost)
components.description: 6px radius, transparent fill, 1px solid #737373 border, Arcade 14px/400 #737373 text. Same dimensions as the live Add-To-Cart button so the grid stays uniform.

components.name: Marquee Tag (Pill Badge)
components.role: Inline label inside buttons and cards
components.description: 9999px radius, 1px solid #000000 border, Arcade 10px/400 #000000, padding 2px 8px. Used for suffixes like 'AR' or sub-tags inside cards.

components.name: Footer Strip
components.description: 1px solid #e5e7eb top border on cream. Left: '© FRANKY'S AMSTERDAM 2023' in Arcade 14px/400 #000000. Right: 'SUBSCRIBE' and 'SHIPPING' in Arcade 14px/700 #000000 acting as ghost links.

components.name: Checkerboard Surface
components.description: Repeating two-tone square grid in #f3e5df and #000000 (or #333333 for shadowed variants). Square size ~48px. Used as the hero panel backdrop and as decorative banding; never as a functional UI surface.

typography.role: Sole typeface across the entire interface — every heading, label, price, button, body and icon is set in Arcade. The 400/700 weight jump is the only hierarchy tool; using a second typeface would shatter the kiosk illusion.
typography.substitute: VT323, Press Start 2P (Google Fonts pixel set) — match the 8-bit, all-caps-leaning look
typography.letterSpacing: normal across all sizes — the font's bitmap grid is the rhythm, not tracking

designSystem.elevationPhilosophy: Elevation is intentionally absent. The system reads as 2D pixel art on cream paper — depth is implied by the receding checkerboard and the 1px inset button bevel, never by soft drop shadows or layered surfaces.
